mapper.select: select sa.id, sa.login_name as "loginName", sa.staff_name as "staffName", sa.role_label as "roleLabel", sa.status, sa.first_login as "firstLogin", s.name as "storeName", s.address, s.contact_phone as "contactPhone", s.business_hours as "businessHours", t.status as "tenantStatus" from staff_account sa join store s on s.id = sa.store_id join tenant t on t.id = sa.tenant_id where sa.id = #{staffId} and sa.tenant_id = #{tenantId}

select sa.id, sa.staff_name as "staffName", sa.role_label as "roleLabel", sa.first_login as "firstLogin", sp.display_name as "displayName", sp.specialty_text as "specialtyText", sp.intro_text as "introText", s.name as "storeName", s.address, s.contact_phone as "contactPhone", s.business_hours as "businessHours", s.business_categories as "businessCategories", s.service_tags as "serviceTags" from staff_account sa join staff_profile sp on sp.staff_account_id = sa.id join store s on s.id = sa.store_id where sa.id = #{staffId} and sa.tenant_id = #{tenantId}
mapper.update: update staff_profile set display_name = #{displayName}, specialty_text = #{specialtyText}, intro_text = #{introText}, updated_at = current_timestamp where staff_account_id = #{staffId} and tenant_id = #{tenantId}
mapper.select: select bs.id as "slotId", si.name as "serviceName", r.name as "resourceName", bs.start_at as "startAt", bs.end_at as "endAt", bs.capacity, bs.reserved_count as "reservedCount", count(b.id) filter (where b.status = 'reserved') as "waitingArrival", count(b.id) filter (where b.status = 'arrived') as "waitingDeduction" from bookable_slot bs join service_item si on si.id = bs.service_item_id join resource r on r.id = bs.resource_id left join booking b on b.bookable_slot_id = bs.id and b.status != 'cancelled' where bs.tenant_id = #{tenantId} and bs.staff_account_id = #{staffId} and bs.start_at::date = current_date and bs.status = 'published' group by bs.id, si.id, r.id order by bs.start_at

select b.id as "bookingId", b.status, m.id as "memberId", m.name as "memberName", ct.name as "cardName", mc.card_type as "cardType", mc.remain_count as "remainCount", mc.valid_until as "validUntil", si.deduct_count as "deductCount" from booking b join member m on m.id = b.member_id join member_card mc on mc.id = b.member_card_id join card_template ct on ct.id = mc.template_id join bookable_slot bs on bs.id = b.bookable_slot_id join service_item si on si.id = bs.service_item_id where b.tenant_id = #{tenantId} and b.bookable_slot_id = #{slotId} and bs.staff_account_id = #{staffId} and b.status != 'cancelled' order by b.id

select b.id, b.status, b.store_id as "storeId", b.member_id as "memberId", b.member_card_id as "memberCardId" from booking b join bookable_slot bs on bs.id = b.bookable_slot_id where b.id = #{bookingId} and b.tenant_id = #{tenantId} and bs.staff_account_id = #{staffId} for update of b

select b.id, b.status, b.store_id as "storeId", b.member_id as "memberId", b.member_card_id as "memberCardId", si.deduct_count as "deductCount", ac.id as "attendanceId" from booking b join bookable_slot bs on bs.id = b.bookable_slot_id join service_item si on si.id = bs.service_item_id left join attendance_confirm ac on ac.booking_id = b.id where b.id = #{bookingId} and b.tenant_id = #{tenantId} and bs.staff_account_id = #{staffId} for update of b

select card_type as "cardType", remain_count as "remainCount", base_status as "baseStatus", valid_from as "validFrom", valid_until as "validUntil" from member_card where id = #{memberCardId} and tenant_id = #{tenantId} for update

select b.id, b.status, dr.id as "deductionId" from booking b join bookable_slot bs on bs.id = b.bookable_slot_id left join deduction_record dr on dr.booking_id = b.id where b.id = #{bookingId} and b.tenant_id = #{tenantId} and bs.staff_account_id = #{staffId} for update of b

select dr.id, dr.booking_id as "bookingId", m.name as "memberName", si.name as "serviceName", dr.deduct_count as "deductCount", dr.before_count as "beforeCount", dr.after_count as "afterCount", dr.deducted_at as "deductedAt", sn.staff_note_text as "staffNoteText" from deduction_record dr join booking b on b.id = dr.booking_id join member m on m.id = dr.member_id join bookable_slot bs on bs.id = b.bookable_slot_id join service_item si on si.id = bs.service_item_id left join service_note sn on sn.booking_id = b.id where dr.tenant_id = #{tenantId} and dr.deducted_by_staff_id = #{staffId} order by dr.deducted_at desc

select id as "deductionId", booking_id as "bookingId", deduct_count as "deductCount", before_count as "beforeCount", after_count as "afterCount", 'deducted' as status from deduction_record where booking_id = #{bookingId} and tenant_id = #{tenantId}
